In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover a single major story shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
Are ATMs in India Becoming Obsolete?
We will talk about how UPI has transformed payments in India, why cash usage remains surprisingly strong, and why ATM operators are struggling despite record amounts of currency in circulation. The story also explores how ATMs are evolving into multi-purpose banking machines and what that means for the future of cash access in India.
